# Interesting AI Creative Projects Since March 2023

Here's a rundown across different creative domains:

---

## 🎵 Music

- **Udio & Suno** launched as major AI music generation platforms, enabling full songs with vocals from text prompts — sparking both excitement and major **record label lawsuits**
- **Heart on My Sleeve** (April 2023) — a viral track mimicking Drake and The Weeknd's voices, briefly appearing on streaming platforms before being pulled, highlighting deepfake music concerns
- **Holly Herndon & Spawn** continued exploring AI as a collaborative instrument in experimental music
- **Paul McCartney** used AI to isolate John Lennon's voice for the Beatles' final song *"Now and Then"* (released November 2023)

---

## 🎨 Visual Art

- **Adobe Firefly** integrated generative AI into Photoshop, making AI art tools mainstream for professionals
- **Refik Anadol's "Unsupervised"** continued at MoMA, one of the most prominent AI art installations in a major museum
- **Google DeepMind's** collaborations with artists through their Artist in Residence program
- Various artists used **Midjourney V5/V6** and **DALL-E 3** for book covers, concept art, and editorial illustration

---

## 🎬 Film & Video

- **"The Crow"** and other productions reportedly used AI for visual effects work
- **"Air"** and other films used AI tools in pre-production concepting
- **Runway ML's Gen-2** enabled short-form video generation, used by indie filmmakers
- **Sora** (OpenAI, early 2024) — text-to-video model that produced strikingly realistic short clips, shown to select creators
- Several **short films** made entirely with AI tools screened at festivals, debating authorship
- **"Here"** (Robert Zemeckis, 2024) used AI de-aging technology extensively

---

## 📚 Literature & Writing

- **AI-generated novels** continued appearing on Amazon, prompting platform policy debates
- Several authors openly collaborated with Claude, GPT-4, and others to draft or edit fiction
- **"1 the Road"** — earlier AI novel experiment gained renewed attention in discussions about AI authorship
- Interactive fiction and AI dungeon-master tools became more sophisticated

---

## 🎭 Theater & Performance

- **"Endgame" with AI commentary** — productions experimenting with AI-generated elements in classical theater
- Live performance artists used real-time AI image generation as stage backdrops

---

## 🎮 Games

- **AI Dungeon** continued evolving
- **Inworld AI** built NPC dialogue systems used by several game studios
- Indie developers used AI tools to create art assets, reducing production costs dramatically
- **GTA VI** and other major titles reportedly incorporated AI in asset creation

---

## 🏆 Notably Controversial / Award-Winning

- **"Theatre D'opéra Spatial"** — Jason Allen's AI image that won a Colorado State Fair art competition (2022, but the debate raged well into 2023)
- **WGA and SAG-AFTRA strikes** (2023) centered heavily on AI rights in creative industries
- **Grammy eligibility rules** for AI music were debated and updated

---

## 🔬 Most Technically Impressive

- **Google's MusicLM** — high-quality music from text descriptions
- **Meta's AudioCraft/MusicGen**
- **Stable Diffusion 3 / SDXL** — open-source image generation improvements
- **GPT-4V** enabling visual creative analysis and collaboration

---

## Notable Themes Running Through All of This:
- **Authorship and copyright** remain deeply contested
- The line between **tool and creator** keeps blurring
- **Industry backlash vs. enthusiast adoption** created cultural tension
- Smaller/indie creators often benefited most from democratized tools

---

*Want me to go deeper on any specific category or project?*
